posts.name: ProfMarks
posts.cooked:
Saw this game in my FLGS today, picked it up and I’m in love. Finally the gateway game for my wife. Thank you SOM!!!

On to the question:

It involves the order of effects when Wraith plays Throat Jab against Baron Blade with Backlash Field up. After Wraith deals damage, does she suffer from the 3 points returned from Backlash before the Throat Jabs second effect, target cannot deal damage until the start of Wraith’s next turn, or does the no damage effect take place prior to the Backlash smacking her?

Reading through the forums, I suspect…Wraith does damage, Backlash does damage, Baron no longer can damage until the start of Wraith’s next turn, but I want to be sure.

Thanks!

posts.cooked: I think your assessment is correct. The effects of Throat Jab are written as two different sentences, so since the Backlash Field is triggered by the first sentence, I believe it would go off before The Wraith’s second sentence takes effect.

posts.name: thad
posts.cooked:
Actually given the current text of the elbow jab card, which now reads as:

the wraith deals 1 target 2 melee
damage.
The target dealt damage this way
cannot deal damage until the
start of your next turn.
Coupled with the clarification of Tachyon's Hypersonic Assault card in the rules FAQ, it now seems rather clear that the intended effect would be for Wraith to deal 2 melee damage to Baron Blade, at which point Blade can no longer deal damage until the start of Wraith's next turn, so the backlash field would be prevented from dealing any damage in response.

Hope people find this useful
